subject.title: [Bug]: Discord elevated allowFrom fallback from channels.discord.allowFrom does not work on 2026.3.22

question: Should Discord elevated authorization continue to inherit `channels.discord.allowFrom` when `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` is omitted, or should elevated exec require an explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` allowlist going forward?
rationale: Current main documents explicit elevated allowlists as required, but the latest release still promised the fallback; choosing whether channel DM authorization implies elevated host-exec eligibility is a security-boundary decision.

options.title: Require explicit elevated allowlists
options.body: Keep current main's explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` requirement and treat the old fallback docs as corrected release documentation.

options.title: Restore the shipped fallback
options.body: Land a focused Discord fallback resolver used by both runtime authorization and `sandbox explain`, with tests for omitted, explicit, and explicit-empty allowlists.

recommendation.title: Require explicit elevated allowlists
recommendation.body: Keep current main's explicit `tools.elevated.allowFrom.discord` requirement and treat the old fallback docs as corrected release documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current docs correction and earlier elevated/plugin architecture commits around this boundary.
